children: Arena REIT's bull at Jefferies takes heart from recent news flow that has helped the stock to recover some losses over the past two months. Arena REIT yesterday raised its FY27 distribution guidance to 19.0-20.2 Australian cents/security. That reflected progress on resolving issues created by Edge Early Learning, one of its childcare center tenants, turning insolvent. Analyst Andrew Dodds says the guidance upgrade "combined with the speed of finding replacement tenants and depth of bidder interest for Edge assets, gives us comfort this was an isolated, tenant-specific event rather than a sector or portfolio-wide issue." It also highlights the quality of Arena REIT's assets. Arena REIT is trading at a 31% discount to net tangible assets, helping to anchor Jefferies's "buy" call on the stock.
